source: Over the real numbers, if a linear system has two distinct solutions, then it has infinitely many, because every point on the line through those two solutions also satisfies the system. Each elementary row operation is reversible and preserves the solution set — that is exactly why elimination is a valid solving method.

Which code correctly builds the string "Age: 19"?
'Age: ' + 19
'Age: ' + str(19)
str('Age: ') + int('19')
19 + 'Age: '

Worked example (name it explicitly): the example is `with open('data.txt') as f: text = f.read()`.
- Show the code line-by-line: with open(...) opens the file, assigns the file object to f.
- f.read() reads the entire contents into `text` as one string.
- The with block closes the file automatically when the block ends (even if an error occurs).
Connect to the anchor quotes: “The read() function reads the contents of a file and returns a string” and “Python supports the opening of a file using the open() function”.
